name: PeopleOps Enterprise HR & Company Operations
description: A production-style, event-driven HRIS, payroll, finance, recruiting, workspace and operations platform built entirely from Pawabase definitions.

policies.name: company_record
policies.description: Company member reading a row in their organization.

policies.name: company_create
policies.description: Company member creates a row only for their organization.

policies.name: employee_self
policies.description: Employee may read/update rows they own.

policies.name: employee_or_hr
policies.description: Employee's private data or an HR administrator.

policies.name: finance_or_manager
policies.description: Finance and managers may decide expenses.

resources.name: organizations
resources.description: Company profile and legal operating entity.

resources.name: organization_settings
resources.description: Company-wide HR, payroll and workflow settings.

resources.name: employee_employment_history
resources.description: Prior roles and internal employment history.

resources.name: employee_documents
resources.description: Private employee files stored in the employee-documents bucket.

resources.name: work_schedules
resources.description: Working days, hours, and holiday calendar.

resources.name: attendance_breaks
resources.description: Break intervals within a clock session.

resources.name: leave_balances
resources.description: Current annual leave balance per employee/type.

resources.name: leave_requests
resources.description: Employee leave requests with approval state.

resources.name: payroll_groups
resources.description: Employees paid together under one calendar.

resources.name: payroll_items
resources.description: One employee's computed pay within a run.

resources.name: employee_loans
resources.description: Loans, salary advances, and repayment schedules.

resources.name: tasks
resources.description: Work items with assignees and state.

resources.name: workspace_blocks
resources.description: Structured blocks belonging to a workspace page.

flows.name: employee_created
flows.description: Fan out a new employee event into lifecycle and notification work.

flows.name: attendance_clocked_in
flows.description: Update operational attendance views without exposing private details.

flows.name: attendance_clocked_out
flows.description: Queue attendance calculation and publish a team-safe update.

flows.name: leave_requested
flows.description: Create approval work and notify the next approver.

flows.name: leave_approved
flows.description: Publish approved leave and update availability.

flows.name: expense_submitted
flows.description: Route an expense through the generic approval engine.

flows.name: payroll_finalized
flows.description: Fan out private employee payslip notifications.

flows.name: candidate_hired
flows.description: Convert a hired candidate into controlled onboarding.

flows.name: task_assigned
flows.description: Notify an assignee and publish a personal task update.

flows.name: document_expiring
flows.description: Escalate document expiry to employee and HR.

flows.name: onboarding_start
flows.description: Create an onboarding run from the selected template, then notify the employee.

flows.name: approval_route
flows.description: Resolve approval stages through a reusable asynchronous queue boundary.

flows.name: attendance_calculate
flows.description: Calculate daily attendance asynchronously; replace with a project function for jurisdiction-specific rules.

flows.name: payslip_publish
flows.description: Generate and publish employee-specific payslips via a dedicated payroll worker.

flows.name: document_expiry_sweep
flows.description: Scheduled document expiry check with retry and HR escalation.

flows.name: missing_clockout_sweep
flows.description: Find and close stale sessions every night.

flows.name: leave_accrual
flows.description: Monthly leave accrual, carryover and ledger creation.

webhooks.name: accounting_sync
webhooks.description: Disabled accounting export; configure a company endpoint before enabling.

inbound-hooks.name: Payroll provider events
inbound-hooks.description: Verified payment results and payroll reconciliation.
